explication: Expr is a Go expression language for safely compiling and evaluating expressions against Go-provided environments. The main workflow is expression input through parsing, static checking and optimization to bytecode, then VM evaluation and a result. Separate capabilities include built-ins, environment/type modeling, AST tools, context/operator patching, documentation generation, debugging and an interactive REPL. The workflow links are grounded in the README and SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled implementation details are not expanded into additional call edges.
